title: Sum of profile decomposition gates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinate set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $a$ be a sequence of signs indexed by the nonnegative integers, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The sum of the real-valued outputs of the $2n$ profile decomposition gates associated with $S$ and $a$, evaluated at $x$, is the sign value $a(c)-a(0)$, where $c$ is the number of coordinates in $S$ at which $x$ equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a sequence of signs indexed by the natural numbers
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n
